intro.title: One account. Wherever you go. Your data.
intro.generic: Create an account on the Atmosphere.
intro.app: To use {{appName}}, you’ll first need an account on the Atmosphere.
intro.network: The Atmosphere is a network of connected apps built on a shared protocol.
intro.hosting: Your account and data are hosted by a provider of your choice.
intro.reuse: Use the same account to sign in to compatible apps across the Atmosphere.
intro.ownership: You can move your account and data to another provider without starting over.

providers.title: Choose an account provider
providers.intro: Your provider hosts your account and handles signup.
providers.empty: No account providers are currently available.
providers.bluesky: A social media company building an open social network on the Atmosphere.
providers.eurosky: A European nonprofit focused on providing independent social infrastructure on the Atmosphere.
providers.blacksky: A community-led social platform focused on safety, community governance, and user control.
providers.w-social: A European social network focused on privacy, authenticity, and human-centered online communities.
providers.northsky: A Canadian nonprofit cooperative building social infrastructure for 2SLGBTQIA+ and marginalized communities.
providers.selfhosted-social: An independent community project providing hosted infrastructure for the Atmosphere.
providers.tangled: A social coding platform for hosting, sharing, and collaborating on Git repositories.
providers.spark: An open-source social networking project focused on customizable, user-controlled feeds.
providers.npmx: A community-built npm client that adds social and discovery features using the Atmosphere.
providers.pckt: An open-web publishing platform focused on blogging, creator ownership, and portable identity.
providers.witchcraft-systems: An independent technology collective operating infrastructure for the Atmosphere and other open internet services from Japan.

complete.title: Your Atmosphere account is ready.
complete.generic: You can now use your account with compatible Atmosphere applications.
complete.app: You’re ready to return to {{appName}}. That app will ask you to sign in separately.
complete.paused: Automatic return paused. You can still use the return button.

errors.title: We couldn’t complete this step
errors.unknownApp: That app is not registered. You can still create an account, but we won’t redirect you afterward.
errors.initialization: The signup client could not start. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unsupportedProvider: This provider’s OAuth configuration is unavailable or unsupported. Try again or choose another provider.
errors.authorization: We couldn’t open the provider’s signup flow. Please try again.
errors.cancelled: Signup authorization was cancelled. You can start again when you’re ready.
errors.callback: We couldn’t verify the signup result. Please start again.
errors.providers: The provider list is unavailable. Please try again.
errors.redirect: This app’s return URL is invalid. Your account is ready, but we won’t redirect you.
errors.cleanup: Your account is ready, but we couldn’t confirm launcher credential cleanup. You can revoke the launcher’s access in your provider’s settings.
